returning: detail: returns to lineup after being a healthy scratch in Toronto's 4-3 loss to the Columbus Blue Jackets on Saturday
away.summary: The Toronto Maple Leafs (8-14-3) are in a difficult stretch, having yet to win a game in November and losing nine straight (0-8-1). They recently suffered a 4-3 loss to the Columbus Blue Jackets after leading 3-1. The projected lineup shows Anthony Stolarz as the first goalie listed, with Sergei Bobrovsky as the backup, and includes the return of Oliver Ekman-Larsson to the defense.

out.detail: shoulder injury, will miss his third straight game

home.summary: The New York Islanders (11-6-5) are riding a seven-game point streak (4-0-3) following a gutsy 3-2 win over the Detroit Red Wings. Simon Holmström extended his point streak to a career-best seven games and leads the team in goals. Ilya Sorokin was in the starter's net during morning skate, indicating he is likely to start against the Maple Leafs, while Ryan Pulock remains out with an upper body injury.
